concern_summary: This concern focuses on handling keyboard shortcuts associated with the right arrow key, enabling actions within the application when the right arrow key is pressed, encompassing functionalities related to user commands triggered by this key.

This concern encompasses key functionalities enhancing accessibility and user experience through arrow key navigation, allowing users to effectively navigate among selectable items using arrow keys, specifically focusing on right arrow interactions.

This concern aggregates functionalities related to the navigation and interaction with carousel attachments, primarily utilizing the right arrow key for cycling through items, managing arrow visibility and enabling smooth user interaction in a carousel format.

This concern encompasses the functionalities related to managing user input in the compose box by handling text changes, validating input length, and submitting messages or attachments, as well as maintaining the draft message state and user interactions with the text input.
Management and tracking of cursor position during text input and modifications, ensuring accurate placement of the cursor after text changes, including emoji replacements and user interactions.
Determination of cursor coordinates to assess available space for rendering menus and displaying autocomplete suggestions, ensuring appropriate placement relative to the cursor's location.
Determination of the cursor style based on the state of interactive components, ensuring a visually consistent and accessible cursor presentation.
Calculation of cursor relative position for displaying popovers, ensuring that contextual menus and reaction lists are accurately positioned based on the cursor's coordinates.
